tools.description: Check data you already have against the page it claims to come from, field by field. Takes extracted data from ANY source — another tool, your own scrape, a stored record — plus a url (or raw html/text) and reports which values actually appear in the source and which do not, with a supporting excerp

tools.name: contrie_watch
tools.description: Watch one public web page for one question and be told when the answer changes. Runs the extraction now as a baseline, then on a schedule with `every` minutes between slots (minimum 15); delayed or missed slots can occur. On a change Contrie records the before and after responses and their evidence

tools.name: contrie_changes
tools.description: Read a monitor's history: its latest answer with evidence status and the last 20 events (baseline, change, error). Every change carries the full before and after responses with evidence, and a diff of the fields that moved. Requires an API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: contrie_extract, contrie_read, contrie_verify · Private data: contrie_extract, contrie_read, contrie_verify, contrie_watch, contrie_changes · Public sink: contrie_watch · Destructive: contrie_account, contrie_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: contrie_extract, contrie_read, contrie_verify · Private data: contrie_extract, contrie_read, contrie_verify, contrie_watch, contrie_changes · Public sink: contrie_watch · Destructive: contrie_account, contrie_watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
